name: Obsidian
short_description: Private, flexible markdown knowledge base that runs in your browser.
description: Obsidian is a powerful knowledge management app built on plain Markdown files. This self-hosted version runs via KasmVNC, delivering the full Obsidian desktop experience in your browser. Notes are stored locally in a Docker volume — never on someone else's server. Supports thousands of community plugins, themes, and bidirectional linking to map your knowledge graph.
usecases: Build a personal knowledge base with linked notes and graph view.
Write long-form content, journals, or documentation in Markdown.
Use community plugins for tasks, calendars, and Kanban boards.
Access your full Obsidian vault remotely from any browser.
notes: Runs Obsidian as a full desktop app via KasmVNC — access it in any browser.
Requires seccomp:unconfined for the browser sandbox to function correctly.
Your vault is stored in the obsidian_config volume under /config/vaults.
